All Road Performance for Commuting, Towing Cargo, Trail Riding in a Comfortable Hybrid Design.
Available in Medium, and an upgraded ST500+ torque pedal assist option
Better Parts = Better Ride & Less Maintenance
Equipped with The Alation ST500 series is unmatched in build quality at the price. 100mm X1 Trail Rated Air Suspension, e350 Hydraulic Brakes, 500/1200w Dapu Motor, SKS Fenders, 800 Lumen Headlamp, Shimano Acera Drivetrain. Better parts offer better steering, handling and benefit a more comfortable and confident ride.
On the Road and On the Trail Performance
Volton's "all-arounder" Alation is perfect for commuting, towing and cargo, and moderate trail riding. Built with strong, light wheels, trail ready air suspension and hydraulic brakes, with a low profile in-frame battery under the rider giving you comfort and unmatched handling at cruising speed and around every turn.
Powerful 500/1200w Dapu Geared Motor
Alation ST500 is powered by a Dapu 48v500w with up 1200 watts of motor output. Volton cadence assist is smooth and comfortable, with a refined soft-start control riders prefer over the jerky and jumpy assist from the competition. Trail rated Tektro E350 hydraulic brakes offer plenty of stopping power.
Strong & Smooth 100mm Air Suspension
SRSuntour X1 Air is stronger and stable with adjustability to benefit a comfortable ride. Light up the lane or trail with a 4x LED 800 Lumen light and keep the machine clean with full length fenders from SKS Germany.
Battery Integrated Frame
Enjoy a quality ride that is built to last - no plastic housing, or bulky frame and rack mountings are used on the Alation. Volton offers some of the best appointed low profile in frame electric bicycle designs since 2012.
Fun for the Family
Volton is know for building bikes with power to share. Invite the kids, tow a trailer and pack some snacks - everyone loves a Volton Electric Bicycle ride!
Responsive US based Support & 2-yr Warranty
Volton stands behind the quality of all Volton bikes with a 2-year parts warranty, and easy to reach US basaed general support. Since 2011 Volton delivers industry leading electric bike performance, and works with a nationwide network of mechanics for assembly and maintenance service. Contact us today with any questions.
